messages.content: Write a riddle about a mongoose. Do not include any tables. Include all of these keywords or phrases at least once: ['2AM']. Write exactly 13 words—no more, no less. (Words are made of English letters; apostrophes inside a word are allowed.) Start your response with this exact line: "I slither through grass.".

Avoid tables completely. Use exactly 13 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) Begin with the line "I glide through grass." and don’t put any other content before it. Make sure each of these appears in the response: ['2AM'].
